experiment: 024-attr-vae (H-A6, docs/08 + docs/09 decisions 1 and 5; pre-declared NON-COUNTING diagnostic, D-018 cycle)

crop.origin: top-left (0,0) of the decoded RGB image: native pixel grid, so the 8-px VAE phase is kept; NO resize in clean
crop.condition_code: experiments/lib/perturb.py apply_condition(crop, cond, key=sha256, seed=0), applied to the 512 crop (as the fov512 arms of 009/011), identical for all classes; the conditioned image is then cut top-left to a multiple of 8 (clean 512, jpeg75_resize05 256, social_sim 358..512 -> <=7 px lost) so the VAE (f8) accepts it

vae_io: uint8 -> float32 [-1,1] -> encode -> latent_dist.mode() -> decode -> (y+1)/2 clamp -> quantised to uint8 (np.rint) between passes (009 convention); fp32, TF32 off; batch <= 4 on GPU (OOM -> halve + retry), same-shape groups

features.e1: RMS(x - x1), x in [0,1], x1 = quantised VAE(x)
features.e2: RMS(x1 - x2), x2 = quantised VAE(x1) (double round trip)
features.hp8: d = mean over RGB of (x - x1); H = d - uniform3x3(d) (reflect); E = H^2; hp8 = 0.5*(CV of the 8 column-phase means of E + CV of the 8 row-phase means), CV = std/mean, phase = index mod 8 (top-left anchored = native grid)
features.extra_cached_not_judged: the 16 raw phase means per VAE (8 col + 8 row)

readouts.logreg: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', max_iter=3000), 3 classes, fixed C (no tuning); fit on train families only
logreg_sources: clean (train images of the clean condition; realistic transfer)
matched (train images under the test condition; T-mix style)
readouts.argmin: no training. A2: SD2 vs SDXL images only, class = argmin over the two VAEs of AEDR (lower = on-manifold, 011); chance 0.5. A3 (3-way): class = argmin_k over {kl-f8: aedr_sd, XL: aedr_xl} if min(aedr) <= tau else 'other', tau = median of min(aedr) over ALL train-family images of that condition (labels never used); descriptive

fallback_cpu_cap.note: Used ONLY if the feature-level D-008 guard fails for sdxl-vae on the GPU, so sdxl must run on CPU. Revised BEFORE any CPU extraction and before any result was read: first draft was 40/class and 20/SD1.x generator from an isolated 26 s/pass timing; the 32-image CPU guard run then measured ~14 s/image (clean), ~27 s/image over 3 conditions, so the coordinator-suggested 120/class (360 images, ~2.7 h) is feasible; SD1.x capped at 50 per generator. Seeded stratified subsample (seed 0). The 8-feature models then run on this subsample and the sd-vae-only models on all 1,020. Preview of the guard (raw feature diffs, 32 images): sdxl log e2/AEDR differ by up to 1.7e-2 CPU vs GPU, so the CPU fallback is expected to be needed.

sd13_sd14.scoring: main-model (trained on main TRAIN families, clean source and matched source) 3-way prediction; report share predicted kl-f8 / XL / other, vs the main test false-map rate of 'other' images into kl-f8 and the SD2 recall; descriptive

secondary.raid: run only if the gen_k -> generator mapping is verifiable from files in the repo (kb/datasets/raid.md: [unverified]); otherwise skipped and stated

label_rule.primary_stat: logreg 3-way bacc, main set, caption-family grouped primary split (seed 0)
label_rule.PASS: clean bacc >= 0.70 AND jpeg75_resize05 bacc >= 0.50 (clean-train source for both, i.e. realistic transfer)
label_rule.KILL: jpeg75_resize05 bacc < 0.45 under BOTH sources (clean-train and matched-train)
label_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise (labels from point estimates, as docs/08; CIs are reported alongside)
label_rule.INVALID: a validity gate fails (permutation control not at chance, duplicate sha256, split not grouped, D-008 > 1e-3)
label_rule.non_counting: docs/09 decision 1: H-A6 does not count toward the D-018 stop rule

d008.images: 16 SD2/SDXL (8+8) + 16 other, seeded (seed 0) from the main set, clean 512 crops
d008.pixel: sd-vae-ft-mse: CUDA vs CPU max |dpixel| of the float outputs x1 and x2 <= 1e-3, else abort. sdxl-vae pixel guard is NOT re-run (009 measured 5.3e-3 on the same kind of crops; failure assumed), only the feature-level guard below decides
d008.feature_logit: all 8 features computed on CPU and on the accelerator for the 32 images x 3 conditions; passed through the FINAL clean-trained logreg: max |dlogit| <= 1e-3. sdxl-vae failed the pixel guard in 009 (5e-3): it is run on CPU unless this feature-level guard passes
